title: OWASP WebGoat: Web-Application Security Lessons
summary: A deliberately insecure teaching application for learning common server-side web-application flaws. Its interactive lessons provide a controlled context for understanding security failures and the need for defensive controls.
defensive_use: Study lesson concepts in an isolated local training setup, recording the relevant trust assumption and prevention principle. Use the material to improve secure-design reasoning without extending exercise activity to third-party systems.
prerequisites: A web browser and the ability to run a local teaching application using a supported deployment option.
Basic HTTP and web-application concepts are helpful.

access.note: OWASP identifies its educational resources as free. Local computing or optional hosting may involve separate costs; no environment was provisioned.

caveats: The publisher warns that running WebGoat makes the host vulnerable, recommends disconnecting from the Internet, and notes that its default configuration binds to localhost.
